title: Digital Marketing Lead
full_description: The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SEO, paid advertising, brand-building activities, and emerging AI-driven search strategies. The candidate should be capable of independently planning, executing, managing, and optimizing digital marketing initiatives to achieve measurable business growth.
responsibilities:
1. SEO & Organic Growth
Strong expertise in Organic SEO and keyword strategy.
Hands-on experience in AEO (Answer Engine Optimization).
Knowledge of GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).
Expertise in Local SEO.
On-page, off-page, and technical SEO optimization.
Experience in driving organic traffic and improving search rankings.

2. Paid Advertising & Performance Marketing
Hands-on experience in Google Ads.
Expertise in Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram).
Experience in planning, executing, and optimizing paid campaigns.
Ability to improve ROI, conversions, and lead generation.
Strong understanding of campaign analytics and performance tracking.

3. Branding & Online Reputation Management
Develop and execute brand visibility and awareness strategies.
Plan and manage brand-related articles and content publications.
Build a strong online brand presence through reviews and reputation management.
Manage and optimize business listings across relevant platforms.
Manage product listings and improve product visibility.
Drive activities that increase brand credibility and customer engagement.

4. Strategy, Analytics & Execution
Develop and implement comprehensive digital marketing strategies.
Monitor campaign performance, traffic, leads, and conversions.
Analyze marketing data and prepare performance reports.
Identify new opportunities for digital growth and brand positioning.
Coordinate with internal teams for content, creative, and campaign execution.
requirements:
7+ years of hands-on experience in Digital Marketing.
Strong understanding of organic and paid marketing channels.
Proven experience in managing campaigns and delivering measurable results.
Ability to independently lead digital marketing initiatives.
Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and execution skills.
nice_to_have:
AI-Powered Content Creation: Experience using Claude and other AI tools for content writing, ideation, research, and marketing content development.
Creative & Design Skills: Basic graphic design skills and the ability to create marketing creatives, social media posts, and campaign assets.
HTML & CSS: Basic working knowledge for website content updates, landing page optimization, and minor website changes.
Familiarity with AI-driven marketing tools and automation.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
full_description: The Talent Acquisition Specialist role at Procyon Technostructure offers an excellent opportunity for experienced professionals to drive end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with hiring managers and leadership teams to identify, attract, and onboard top talent, while enhancing candidate engagement and contributing to the organization’s overall hiring strategy and growth objectives.
responsibilities:
Assist in sourcing and screening candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, and other hiring platforms.
Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
Assist in drafting job descriptions, job postings, and recruitment emails.
Support employer branding initiatives by engaging with potential candidates and promoting company culture.
Conduct initial candidate outreach and pre-screening calls.
Collaborate with internal teams to understand hiring needs and job requirements.
Assist in onboarding new hires by coordinating documentation and orientation sessions.
Provide administrative support to the HR team on various talent acquisition tasks.
requirements:
Strong interest in recruitment, talent acquisition, or human resources.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) is a plus.

title: Business Development Manager, IT Staffing
full_description:
We are looking for a driven and results-oriented Business Development Manager to grow our IT staffing and staff augmentation business by acquiring new clients, developing strategic relationships, and expanding existing accounts. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in selling IT staffing or staff augmentation services, generating new business opportunities, engaging client decision-makers, and closing staffing contracts.  

This role is best suited for a sales professional with a strong hunter mentality, an established network or the ability to build one, and a proven ability to generate staffing revenue.
responsibilities:
Identify, prospect, and acquire new clients for IT staffing, contract staffing, and staff augmentation services. 

Generate qualified leads through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, networking, referrals, and industry connections. 

Identify organizations with ongoing or upcoming IT resource requirements and develop targeted business opportunities. 

Build relationships with key decision-makers, including CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors, Engineering Managers, Talent Acquisition Heads, HR leaders, and vendor management teams. 

Pitch Procyon’s IT staffing and staff augmentation capabilities to prospective clients. 

Understand client hiring needs, technical skill requirements, contract duration, resource volumes, location preferences, and commercial expectations. 

Develop and manage a strong sales pipeline, from initial prospecting through opportunity qualification, negotiation, and contract closure. 

Negotiate billing rates, margins, payment terms, contract duration, and other commercial conditions to ensure profitable engagements. 

Coordinate closely with recruitment and delivery teams to communicate client requirements, validate candidate availability, and support timely fulfilment. 

Follow up on submitted profiles, interviews, offers, onboarding, extensions, and additional resource requests to grow client accounts. 

Foster client relationships and account expansion. 

Monitor staffing market trends, competitor activities, client demand, and emerging skill requirements. 

Achieve agreed targets for new client acquisition, staffing requirements, placements, gross margin, and revenue.
requirements:
Any graduate with excellent communication. 

Proven experience in business development or sales within IT staffing, staff augmentation, contract staffing, or recruitment services. 

Strong understanding of the Technical IT staffing business model, including bill rates, pay rates, gross margins, contract terms, and resource fulfilment. 

Demonstrated experience in new client acquisition and generating staffing business from new accounts. 

Experience engaging enterprise clients, staffing partners, vendor management organizations, and talent acquisition leaders. 

Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, networking, and relationship management skills. 

Ability to manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to client onboarding and account growth. 

Familiarity with CRM tools, sales pipeline management, and business reporting.

title: Business Development Associate
short_description: Graduate sales role across IT staffing and engineering services. Strong communication matters more than experience.
full_description:
Procyon Technostructure is hiring freshers into our Business Development team in Chennai.

You'll work across two sides of our business - IT Staffing, where we help companies hire the engineering talent they need, and Product & Engineering Services, where we take on development, cloud, data, and automation work directly. Which side you lean into will depend on where you show strength; most people start with exposure to both.

Day to day, you'll research target companies, reach out to decision-makers over calls, email, and LinkedIn, understand what they're trying to build or hire for, and set up conversations for the senior team. As you learn the market, you'll start handling those conversations yourself - qualifying requirements, presenting our capabilities, and eventually owning accounts of your own.

We're being straightforward about what this involves: a lot of outreach, a lot of rejection early on, and a real learning curve on the technology side. What we're looking for is someone who communicates clearly, stays persistent, and is genuinely curious about how technology businesses work. Everything else we'll teach you.

You'll be trained on our service lines, the technology landscape we sell into - Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Full Stack, DevOps, Data Engineering, AI, Cloud, QA Automation - and the tools and process we use to run a pipeline.
responsibilities:
Research target companies and identify the right decision-makers to approach
Reach out to prospects daily through calls, emails, and LinkedIn
Follow up consistently until you get a clear answer
Set up introductory meetings for the senior team
Understand what a client is hiring for or building, and capture the requirement accurately
Present Procyon's staffing and engineering services confidently
Pass requirements to the recruitment and delivery teams without losing detail
Log every conversation and next step in the CRM
Meet monthly targets for outreach, meetings, and qualified leads
Learn the technology landscape we sell into and grow into owning accounts
requirements:
Bachelor's degree in any discipline -  Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or Computer Science are all welcome
Excellent spoken and written English; able to hold a confident conversation with senior professionals
Comfortable making outbound calls and sending cold emails on a daily basis
Genuine interest in technology and how software and engineering services are sold
Strong listening skills - able to understand a client's requirement and repeat it back accurately
Persistent and resilient; able to keep going through slow weeks and unanswered outreach
Organised, with the discipline to track every conversation and follow up on time
Willing to learn and take feedback from senior team members
Based in Chennai or willing to relocate, and able to work from office
nice_to_have:
Internship or part-time experience in sales, business development, inside sales, or customer-facing work
Any exposure to recruitment, staffing, or the IT services industry
Familiarity with LinkedIn as a research and outreach tool
Basic understanding of software development or cloud technologies
Exposure to CRM tools, or willingness to pick one up quickly
Participation in college placement, marketing, or event committees - anything showing initiative and people skills

title: Full Stack Developer (Backend-Focused)

title: QA Engineer (Manual + API Testing)
short_description: Ensure software quality through functional testing, API testing, and backend validation in an Agile team.
full_description: We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented QA Engineer with 3+ years of experience to join our technology team. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring software quality and stability through functional testing, API testing, and backend validation. While exposure to automation, integrations, and AI-assisted testing is preferred, we are primarily looking for someone with a strong QA foundation and hands-on testing experience who is willing to learn and grow. The QA Engineer will work closely with developers, business analysts, project managers, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment to ensure timely and high-quality releases.
responsibilities:
Design, create, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scenarios
Perform Functional, Regression, Smoke and Sanity Testing
Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validate business requirements
Perform API testing using Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI (SoapUI nice-to-have)
Validate request/response payloads, authentication, error handling and API responses
Perform database validation using SQL queries; validate backend data consistency
Identify, log, track and manage defects in JIRA / Azure DevOps
Work closely with developers for issue resolution; retest fixes and validate release readiness
Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot) for test case generation, test data, API payloads, SQL assistance, defect/root-cause analysis and documentation
Participate in Agile ceremonies, daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives
requirements:
2+ years of QA / testing experience
Strong understanding of Functional Testing, Regression Testing, API Testing, SQL/Database Validation
Hands-on with Postman, JIRA, test case creation and execution
Strong debugging and analytical skills
Good written and verbal communication
Mandatory tools: Postman, JIRA, SQL Developer/DBeaver/SSMS, Browser Developer Tools
AI productivity tools: Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot (or equivalent)
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
nice_to_have:
Basic knowledge of automation frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright)
Exposure to enterprise integrations such as TIBCO, Boomi, MuleSoft
Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and cloud environments
Experience with TestRail / Zephyr
Regular usage of AI tools for improving QA productivity

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in Java-based enterprise systems (Spring Boot, Microservices) and proven expertise in AI/ML architecture, model lifecycle management, and scalable AI deployment. This role requires bridging traditional backend systems with advanced AI capabilities.
responsibilities:
Define AI architecture aligned with enterprise Java ecosystems
Design scalable AI-driven microservices and hybrid systems combining rule engines, ML models and APIs
Establish AI integration patterns for existing Java applications
Design and develop backend services using Java (8/11/17+), Spring Boot and Microservices
Integrate AI/ML models into Java systems; build REST APIs for model inference
Implement asynchronous processing with Kafka / RabbitMQ
Integrate Python-based ML models with Java services; design model serving (REST, gRPC)
Implement RAG architectures with vector databases; manage model versioning and lifecycle
Deploy AI systems on AWS / Azure with Docker and Kubernetes

10+ years of Java enterprise development
Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices and REST API development
Strong AI fundamentals, supervised/unsupervised learning, regression/classification, clustering, neural networks, NLP, evaluation metrics, bias/variance/overfitting and explainability
Experience integrating AI models into production systems
Experience with ML frameworks (TensorFlow / PyTorch / Scikit-learn)
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS / Azure)

Experience in Healthcare / Insurance / FinTech domain
